decisions.subject: NB54361-L
decisions.summary: NB54361-L rejected as substitute for NB54360 on PSM-28 Rev 2
decisions.reason: Fails thermal derating at 70C ambient in sealed avionics enclosures (TR-112)

evidence.quote: Decision: we reject NB54361-L as a substitute for NB54360 on PSM-28 Rev 2 because it fails thermal derating at 70C ambient in sealed avionics enclosures (TR-112). Keep NB54360. Logging this as DEC-117.
NB54361-L on PSM-28 Rev 2 went into thermal shutdown at 68C ambient under full load in the sealed enclosure. NB54360 held regulation through 70C with margin.
